text.arabic_uthmani: وَعُرِضُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ صَفًّۭا لَّقَدْ جِئْتُمُونَا كَمَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۭ ۚ بَلْ زَعَمْتُمْ أَلَّن نَّجْعَلَ لَكُم مَّوْعِدًۭا

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction carrying the prior gathering into the presentation scene
words.prose: The opening {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the ayah joined to the previous scene rather than starting a detached tableau. It lets the logic of total gathering in 18:47 cross directly into display before the Rabb, so the first word already turns cosmic assembly into presentation.

topics.headline: continuation into presentation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the display scene is the next result of the preceding gathering, not an isolated new scene.
topics.reason: QAC reads the particle as resumptive or sequential, and the boundary rows coherently connect 18:47 gathering with 18:48 presentation.

words.gloss_range: perfect passive presentation or exposure for review before authority
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes presenting, exposing, offering, breadth, and turning away; this scene selects passive display for inspection
words.prose: The perfect passive {{ar:عُرِضُوا}} ({{tr:ʿuriḍū}}) makes the crowd already placed under review, with the presenter left implicit and the displayed people foregrounded. The following authority frame and row-state narrow the root away from casual offering toward exposed exhibition for judgment. It also pivots 18:47 from moving landscape and gathered humanity into a still lineup before direct speech begins.

topics.headline: passive exposure before authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that human agency recedes as the gathered people are already displayed for inspection before lordship.
topics.reason: The QAC form is perfect passive 3mp, and the local frame {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) plus {{ar:رَبِّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbika}}) and {{ar:صَفًّۭا}} ({{tr:ṣaffan}}) selects display before authority rather than unrelated offering branches.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking presentation before or under higher authority

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: governed Rabb term that supplies the authority endpoint

words.prose: {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) makes the display an authority relation, not a journey phrase. Because it governs {{ar:رَبِّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbika}}) immediately after the passive verb, the reader first hears before whom the crowd is exposed and only then hears the rowed formation.

topics.headline: authority-bearing preposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the displayed people are under review before authority, not merely moving toward a location.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a preposition governing the genitive, and attachment evidence binds it to {{ar:رَبِّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbika}}) as the complement of the passive display.

words.gloss_range: your Rabb as the governed authority before whom the display occurs
words.root_gloss_range: lordship range includes mastery, nurture, ownership, sustaining, and ordering; here it frames judgment display and creation-return accountability

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: preposition that governs the Rabb term as the endpoint of display

words.prose: {{ar:رَبِّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbika}}) is genitive under {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}), but lexically it names the authority who receives the displayed crowd. The construct with the second-person suffix keeps the scene reported to the Prophet as your Rabb, while the singular lordship title gathers the many displayed people under one sustaining and judging authority.

topics.headline: lordship as reviewing authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that judgment is framed by Rabb-language and oriented to the Prophet before the crowd is directly addressed.
topics.reason: The preposition makes the word the endpoint of display, the 2ms suffix marks the prophetic addressee, and the r-b-b range supports authority and sustaining lordship in a creation-return scene.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative state: arranged in a row or formation
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes arranging side by side, ranks, rows, and laid-out exposure; here it selects visible ordered formation
words.prose: {{ar:صَفًّۭا}} ({{tr:ṣaffan}}) closes the opening clause by naming the crowd’s state: displayed as one ordered formation. The singular indefinite accusative does not count separate rows; it compresses the many into a visible rank-state. The root’s side-by-side and laid-out pressure, together with the doubled sound, makes the arrangement feel formally pressed into visible alignment; angelic row parallels such as 89:22 remain echoes rather than the local subject.

topics.headline: circumstantial row-state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the people are not merely displayed; they are compressed into an ordered, visible formation for inspection.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as an accusative ḥāl describing the passive subject; broader laid-flat imagery is retained only as exposure pressure within the selected row-formation sense.

words.gloss_range: emphatic lām prefixed to the certainty particle

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: certainty particle bound with the emphatic lām in the arrival assertion

words.prose: The emphatic {{ar:لَّ}} ({{tr:la}}) opens the direct address with pressure rather than neutral report. Bound to {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}), it makes the coming-clause resistant-proof for the very audience whose denial will soon be quoted.

topics.headline: emphatic arrival assertion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speech begins by overmatching denial with emphatic certainty.
topics.reason: QAC identifies emphatic lām before {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}), and the rows tie that emphasis to the later denial.

words.gloss_range: certainty particle before a perfect verb, marking realized completion
words.prose: {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) turns the coming into completed fact before the verb is heard. In the judgment address, the denied future is no longer hypothetical; it has become realized arrival.

topics.headline: realized arrival certainty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that arrival is stated as accomplished reality, not as possibility or future threat.
topics.reason: QAC identifies {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) as a certainty particle before the perfect verb, matching the CRITICAL realized-event rows.

words.gloss_range: you have come to Us: perfect active arrival with 2mp subject and 1p object suffix
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes coming, arriving, occurring, and reaching; here it selects completed arrival at the divine speaker, whether willing or compelled
words.prose: {{ar:جِئْتُمُونَا}} ({{tr:jiʾtumūnā}}) turns the displayed third-person crowd into addressed second-person participants: you have come to Us. The suffixes put you and Us inside one arrival word, so the destination is not a distant phrase but the divine speaker. The wording also joins the known creation-return formula of 6:94, while this ayah adds the prior rowed display.

topics.headline: direct arrival and person shift
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same gathered crowd become addressed you, with arrival compressed into direct confrontation with Us.
topics.reason: The perfect verb carries a 2mp subject and 1p object suffix, attachment evidence treats the suffix as the object complement, and recurrence rows connect the phrase with the 6:94 resurrection-address formula.

words.gloss_range: comparative kāf linking arrival to the creation clause
words.prose: {{ar:كَ}} ({{tr:ka}}) begins the comparison that makes their arrival answer to first creation. Its payoff is not decorative likeness: the present return is interpreted by the original creative act while likeness and distinction remain visible.

topics.headline: arrival measured by creation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the comparison is the argument: present arrival is measured against first creation.
topics.reason: QAC identifies comparison kāf, and attachment binds the comparative phrase to the arrival verb.

words.gloss_range: clause-linking mā in the comparison, allowing act or manner of creation as source
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) lets the comparison take the creation act as its source, while its surface also leaves the manner broad. The phrase therefore does not over-specify how they were first created; it compresses the whole origination act into the proof.

topics.headline: creation act as comparison source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the comparison can point to Our creating you as an act, while the surface leaves the manner broad.
topics.reason: QAC labels it relative, while CRITICAL maṣdariyya pressure survives as a valid act-of-creating reading; the local payoff is broad comparison source, not a new lexical referent.

words.gloss_range: We created you: completed divine origination with the addressees as object
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes creating, forming, measuring, innate constitution, and fabricating; here true divine creation and measured origination are selected
words.prose: {{ar:خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ}} ({{tr:khalaqnākum}}) supplies the proof inside the speech: the same you who have come were once created by the speaking We. The affixes preserve creator-created asymmetry in one word, and the wording participates in the creation-return formula also heard at 6:94. The root’s measuring and forming range strengthens the first-creation argument, while fabrication senses survive only as contrast with the later unwarranted claim.

topics.headline: divine creation as proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that first creation is the proof for return, with creator-created asymmetry held inside one word.
topics.reason: The verb is active perfect 1p with a 2mp object suffix; broader fabrication associations are narrowed to contrast because the local selected sense is true divine origination.

words.gloss_range: accusative temporal ordinal: first, in construct with the following instance noun
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes firstness, origin, priority, return, and interpretation; here origin-point firstness is selected

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: instance noun that completes the first-time construct

words.prose: {{ar:أَوَّلَ}} ({{tr:awwala}}) makes creation an origin point in a countable sequence, not a vague statement of createdness. As a temporal accusative in construct with {{ar:مَرَّةٍۭ}} ({{tr:marratin}}), it lets the first event become the template by which the present arrival is read.

topics.headline: first instance as origin point
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that first creation is specified as a countable origin point that implies repeatability.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as an accusative temporal element in construct with {{ar:مَرَّةٍۭ}} ({{tr:marratin}}); return-field pressure is retained as implication, not as a replacement for the ordinal sense.

words.gloss_range: genitive instance noun completing first time
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes passing, traversal, bitterness, and countable occurrence; here counted instance is selected with passage pressure
words.prose: {{ar:مَرَّةٍۭ}} ({{tr:marratin}}) turns firstness into a counted occurrence: a first time. The genitive construct makes origination an event-token that can be compared with return, matching a resurrection-argument formula seen at 6:94 and 17:51 and a first-passage pattern at 17:7. Passing and bitterness associations are secondary color; the local sense is the countable instance needed for the proof.

topics.headline: countable first instance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that first creation is framed as one occurrence, making repeatability conceptually available.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as the genitive complement of {{ar:أَوَّلَ}} ({{tr:awwala}}); the m-r-r field supports passage color, but local construct grammar selects counted occurrence rather than bitterness as the sense.

words.gloss_range: adversative particle redirecting from proof to accusation
words.prose: {{ar:بَلْ}} ({{tr:bal}}) is the ayah’s hard turn. After the emphatic fact of arrival and the first-creation proof, it redirects the speech into accusation: rather, you claimed. The particle keeps fact and false claim from blending into a smooth continuation.

topics.headline: proof-to-accusation pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah turns from established reality to exposure of the contrary denial.
topics.reason: QAC marks an adversative conjunction, and the structural rows show it dividing the proof beat from the claim beat.

words.gloss_range: you claimed or alleged: completed 2mp assertion with an explicit content clause
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes claim, allegation, assertion, and guarantee or leadership; here unwarranted claim is selected, with self-guarantee pressure
words.prose: {{ar:زَعَمْتُمْ}} ({{tr:zaʿamtum}}) labels the denial as a completed claim made by the very you now addressed. Its content is not vague, because the following clause states exactly what they alleged would never happen; 6:94 gives the closest parallel for the same confrontation of claims with realized return. The root’s allegation force means the ayah reports their speech as unwarranted, and the guarantee side of the field sharpens the irony: they acted as if they could guarantee no appointment.

topics.headline: unwarranted claim with explicit content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial is not neutral belief but an alleged claim whose exact content is exposed.
topics.reason: The perfect verb governs the following content clause, and the lexical rows support claim or allegation rather than neutral thinking; parallels such as 64:7 and 6:94 support the denial-of-return profile.

words.gloss_range: fused subordinator plus future negator introducing the denied content clause
words.prose: {{ar:أَلَّن}} ({{tr:allan}}) compresses that plus never into one visible unit. It marks the following clause as the content of their claim and puts categorical future negation over the making of the appointment. The nasal pressure with the next verb reinforces the tight bond between denial and the act denied.

topics.headline: fused content and future negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that their claim is both subordinated as reported content and made maximally negative toward the future.
topics.reason: QAC treats the word as a compound of subordination and {{ar:لَنْ}} ({{tr:lan}}), governing the following subjunctive verb.

words.gloss_range: We would make, establish, or designate: subjunctive imperfect under future negation
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes making, placing, appointing, transforming, assigning, and designating; with the appointment object it selects establishing or designating

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: fused subordinator and future negator governing the verb
dative phrase routing the appointment toward the addressees
appointment object that narrows making to establishment or designation

words.prose: {{ar:نَّجْعَلَ}} ({{tr:najʿala}}) is the denied verbal center of the accusation. Under {{ar:أَلَّن}} ({{tr:allan}}), the imperfect subjunctive targets future establishment, not past creation. With {{ar:لَكُمْ}} ({{tr:lakum}}) and {{ar:مَّوْعِدًۭا}} ({{tr:mawʿidan}}), the broad making root narrows to appointing or establishing a meeting-point, distinct from the earlier creation verb.

topics.headline: negated future appointment-making
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied act is future establishment of an appointment, distinct from first creation.
topics.reason: The direct object {{ar:مَّوْعِدًۭا}} ({{tr:mawʿidan}}) and dative {{ar:لَكُمْ}} ({{tr:lakum}}) select appointment-establishment from the j-ʿ-l range; same-surah rows point to later appointment assertions at 18:59 and 18:98.

words.gloss_range: for you or toward you: dative preposition plus 2mp suffix governed by the making verb
words.root_gloss_range: surface is lām plus pronoun; supplied w-l-y field adds nearness, relation, protection, and allegiance pressure but does not override the prepositional function

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: making verb that governs the dative phrase

words.prose: {{ar:لَكُمْ}} ({{tr:lakum}}) routes the denied appointment toward the addressees before the object lands. It is a dative complement of {{ar:نَّجْعَلَ}} ({{tr:najʿala}}), not a possession clause, so the issue is what God would establish for or against them. The plural suffix keeps the same accused collective in view, and same-surah appointment echoes such as 18:59 show that this recipient logic will be answered.

topics.headline: dative affected recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the appointment is routed toward the very addressees as affected recipients, not treated as something already possessed.
topics.reason: QAC marks preposition plus suffix, and attachment makes it the complement governed by {{ar:نَّجْعَلَ}} ({{tr:najʿala}}); w-l-y associations are retained only as relational pressure around the dative.

words.gloss_range: an appointed time, place, or meeting-point; the accusative object of the denied making
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes promise, threat, appointment, and fulfillment; the noun of time/place grounds promise and warning in a concrete meeting-point
words.prose: {{ar:مَّوْعِدًۭا}} ({{tr:mawʿidan}}) is the final object and semantic landing point of the ayah: the appointment they claimed would not be made. Its noun-of-time/place form turns promise or warning into a scheduled convergence, and the indefinite accusative leaves the appointment vast while still one real object. The word closes the display by naming what the display has made unavoidable, with same-surah recurrence at 18:58 and 18:59 keeping the denial under pressure.

topics.headline: final appointed meeting-point
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah lands on the exact object they denied: a promised or threatened meeting-point fixed into appointment.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment make it the accusative object of {{ar:نَّجْعَلَ}} ({{tr:najʿala}}); the local NOUN_TIME_PLACE form selects appointed meeting-point while promise and threat senses remain grounded in the appointment noun.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive presentation, the relation to "your Lord," and the accusative "in a row."
baseline_models.mechanism: A passive bringing-into-view places every person before sovereign Lordship, while the straight row converts a crowd into a leveled and inspectable order.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate display makes the gathering a scene of public inspection.
Sovereign ownership identifies the authority before whom the display occurs.
Alignment on a straight line supplies the leveling and inspectability of the gathered people.

changed_reading.before: A resurrected crowd is merely shown to God in rows.
changed_reading.after: Every person is deliberately brought into view before sovereign Lordship in a leveled, inspectable order that suspends prior rank.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: "You have come to Us as We created you the first time" followed by the denied appointment.
baseline_models.mechanism: Present arrival is measured against the originating act: the first creation supplies the operative precedent, a single temporal occurrence marks its beginning, and the appointed time or place gives the return a fixed terminus that unsupported assertion cannot cancel.

activation_trace.role: Actual arrival anchors the scene as obtained presence rather than remote prediction.
Prior measuring and formation make original creation the pattern against which return is read.
Originary bringing-into-being supplies the demonstrated capacity behind the present arrival.
Beginning and priority identify creation's inaugural occurrence as the comparison point.
A bounded occurrence supplies the temporal unit recalled by "first time."
A fixed time or place turns the return from a vague future into a determined encounter.
An uncertain assertion supplies the inadequate speech-act set against demonstrated creation and actual arrival.

changed_reading.before: Resurrection repeats creation, despite their mistaken denial of a future meeting.
changed_reading.after: Their obtained arrival is already measured by the demonstrated first creation and terminates at a fixed appointment that their unsupported assertion could never annul.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding material cycle breaks the flourishing surface into dry fragments and disperses it, while what endures returns as recompense before the same Lord. Presentation in 18:48 therefore follows a stripping process: unstable display is removed and enduring consequence is what can be ordered before God.

activation_trace.role: Bringing persons into view supplies the final display after the preceding material collapse.
Dry, broken vegetation supplies the loss of integrated worldly form.
Wind-driven scattering removes the broken material from any stable arrangement.
Continuance distinguishes what survives the dispersal and remains relevant before the Lord.
Recompense returning to its worker turns endurance into consequential return rather than static survival.

structural_cues: 18:45 moves from water, mixture, and growth to broken matter scattered by wind; 18:46 contrasts temporary adornment with enduring good before "your Lord."
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disintegration, dispersal, endurance, and returned recompense; I infer that these form the stripping-and-retention process behind the focus display. Alternatively, 18:45-46 may only contrast worldly and lasting value without specifying the mechanics of presentation.

changed_reading.before: The row is a static arrangement of resurrected people.
changed_reading.after: The row is the ordered remainder after worldly forms and displays have disintegrated, with enduring consequence carried into view.

context_deltas.mechanism: The removal of mountains leaves the earth visibly exposed, and an exhaustive mustering drives every individual toward one destination without remainder. The focus row is thus not ceremonial spacing alone but the human counterpart of an uncovered landscape and a no-omission collection.

activation_trace.role: Public display receives the uncovered and exhaustive force supplied by the prior scene.
Straight alignment converts exhaustive gathering into a visible human order.
Uncovering and visible emergence supply the exposed field on which presentation becomes total.
Driving and collecting a group toward one destination supplies the motion into the row.
Leaving something behind is explicitly negated, making the collection remainderless.
Negation with an individual term extends the no-remainder claim to every single person.

structural_cues: 18:47 sequences terrain removal, exposed earth, gathering, and the negation of leaving even one person before 18:48 states the row.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an uncovered earth and exhaustive mustering; I infer that the focus row is the terminal geometry of that process. Alternatively, exposure of earth and alignment of people may be parallel images without a causal relation.

changed_reading.before: People stand in an orderly row before God.
changed_reading.after: After shelters and elevations are removed, every last person is driven onto an exposed field and resolved into a no-omission line.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah places a binding record, exhaustively counts small and great, and makes performed acts present. The focus presentation therefore opens an evidentiary field in which persons are not displayed alone: their acts arrive with them in inspectable form.

activation_trace.role: Display anchors the focus scene and receives an evidentiary extension from the following ayah.
A written fixation that entails judgment supplies the durable record beside the displayed persons.
Exhaustive enumeration makes the evidentiary field fine-grained rather than merely representative.
Intentional acts identify what accompanies each presented agent.
Near, witnessed presence turns past action into something concurrently available for inspection.

structural_cues: 18:49 follows the presentation immediately with passive placement of the book, visual reaction, exhaustive scope, and the finding of deeds present.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies displayed persons, a placed record, exhaustive count, and present deeds; I infer a single evidentiary scene joining agents to acts. Alternatively, the book scene may be a subsequent stage rather than part of what "presented" functionally includes.

changed_reading.before: Only the resurrected persons are presented.
changed_reading.after: Persons are presented together with an exhaustive, presently inspectable history of what they intentionally did.

context_deltas.mechanism: The denied appointment belongs to a failed attempt to assign support and agency elsewhere: chosen allies replace the true authority, misleading powers are imagined as helpers, and claimed partners are called but cannot answer. The focus contrast between their claim and God's making of an appointment is then enacted by God's making of an unbridgeable separation between claimants and claimed supports.

activation_trace.role: Uncertain assertion anchors the humanly authored account in which no appointment will be made.
Divine causing-to-be anchors the appointment as an imposed state, not a negotiated human forecast.
Chosen protective alliance supplies the rival support structure behind the human claim.
A strengthening helper is explicitly denied, removing auxiliary agency from creation.
The repeated uncertain claim identifies the supposed partners as products of the same unreliable speech.
Failed verbal response demonstrates the operational absence of the claimed supports.
A second divine causing-to-be realizes the order that replaces the claimants' imagined order.
A barrier between parties gives material form to the collapse of protective partnership.

structural_cues: 18:50 asks whether hostile substitutes are taken as allies; 18:51 denies their witness or assistance in creation; 18:52 stages the failed summons and repeats both claim and divine making.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies substituted allies, denied assistance, repeated claims, failed response, and a divinely made barrier; I infer that denial of the appointment depends on an imagined rival agency network. Alternatively, these ayat may condemn alliance independently of the earlier denial's logic.

changed_reading.before: They simply held an incorrect opinion that no meeting was set.
changed_reading.after: Their denial voices a rival ordering of agency and protection; at the encounter, its claimed supports fail and divine making installs separation instead.

context_deltas.mechanism: Varied examples are repeatedly turned before people, yet argument demands an inherited pattern or punishment in direct confrontation. Against that demand, "as We created you the first time" invokes an origin that itself had no prior specimen: return is grounded in the Creator's inaugural act, not in the denier's requirement that the future conform to a familiar pattern.

activation_trace.role: Originary creation supplies an achieved act whose possibility did not depend on a prior humanly visible model.
Priority marks that achieved creation as inaugural and therefore prior to any precedent.
Turning material through multiple forms supplies repeated explanatory variation.
The presented example supplies a visible pattern intended to mediate understanding.
Entwined dispute turns explanatory variation into resistance rather than reception.
A recurrent inherited way supplies the demanded pattern of the former peoples.
Face-to-face confrontation supplies the alternative demand for unmediated proof.

structural_cues: The focus comparison uses "as" with first creation; 18:54-55 juxtaposes many examples with continued argument and a demand for ancestral pattern or direct confrontation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inaugural creation, varied examples, dispute, inherited pattern, and confrontation; I infer that the first creation rebuts a demand for prior precedent. Alternatively, the comparison may concern only the condition of return and not an epistemic argument about novelty.

changed_reading.before: First creation is merely proof that recreation is possible.
changed_reading.after: First creation also defeats the demand that return must resemble a familiar prior pattern before it can be credited.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root moves from voluntary turning-aside in 18:57 to involuntary presentation in 18:48. Forgetting and perceptual coverings describe attempted non-reception, while the hands have already advanced acts; presentation reverses that orientation by bringing both the avoider and what was sent ahead into view.

activation_trace.role: Being brought into view supplies the compelled orientation that closes the reversal.
Turning one's side and withdrawing supplies the earlier self-directed orientation away from the signs.
Deliberate or functional neglect extends bodily turning-away into abandoned recollection.
Advancing something forward gives past action a trajectory toward the later encounter.
What the hands acquired anchors responsibility for the material already sent ahead.
Protective covering supplies the attempted insulation of inward reception.
Weight in the ear supplies blocked auditory reception alongside the covered heart.

structural_cues: 18:57 coordinates turning away, forgetting, what the hands advanced, coverings over hearts, and weight in ears; the focus uses the same root in the passive presentation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a lexical reversal plus blocked reception and advanced deeds; I infer a directional reversal from self-concealment to compelled exposure. Alternatively, the two senses of the shared root may simply contrast rhetorically without describing a causal reversal.

changed_reading.before: Presentation is only something done to the resurrected.
changed_reading.after: Presentation reverses their earlier self-positioning: those who turned aside and covered reception are turned back into view with what their own hands sent ahead.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later repetition of the appointment is explicitly opposed to hastened punishment and placed under forgiving Lordship and mercy. Delay is therefore not evidence of no appointment but its merciful interval; the destroyed towns then show the same making of a deadline at collective scale, with no refuge once it matures.

activation_trace.role: A fixed appointment anchors the deadline whose apparent delay is being interpreted.
Merciful tenderness supplies a positive reason for interval rather than immediate seizure.
Acceleration and bringing-forward are counterfactually denied, defining the appointment against haste.
The repeated fixed time or place identifies structured delay, not cancellation.
Refuge and escape are negated, making the matured appointment inescapable.
Falling into destruction supplies the realized endpoint assigned to the towns.
Causing something to occupy a state links the towns' deadline to the focus claim that no appointment would be made.
A further fixed appointment scales the mechanism from the focus audience to historical communities.

structural_cues: 18:58 uses "but" to replace hypothetical hastening with an appointment under mercy, then denies refuge; 18:59 joins destruction, wrongdoing, divine making, and another appointment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mercy, non-hastening, repeated appointment, no refuge, and appointed town-destruction; I infer that delay is a merciful component of the deadline mechanism. Alternatively, mercy may explain only postponed punishment, while the focus appointment remains a broader resurrection term.

changed_reading.before: The appointment is simply a threatened future date denied by the audience.
changed_reading.after: Its interval is mercy rather than absence: punishment is not accelerated, but the divinely made deadline remains fixed and offers no refuge when reached.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the passive verb most directly selects deliberate presentation, while the same root's worldly-goods branch is nominal and lateral. The nearby collapse of wealth and adornment keeps the activation anchored and useful: render it only as an "as if" reversal, not as a replacement lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The root of "they were presented" also carries a branch for transient worldly goods or substitutes.

activation_trace.role: Worldly goods and substitute value make the focus presentation resonate with the display-value that has just failed.
Accumulated wealth supplies the possessed display whose status is temporary.
Adornment supplies the visible social surface attached to wealth and descendants.
Broken dry matter supplies the collapse of the prior display's material carrier.

changed_reading.before: Owners arrive after their possessions have ceased to matter.
changed_reading.after: As if in a reversal of worldly display, once goods and adornment collapse, their possessors themselves become what is exposed before the Lord.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because "first" directly selects temporal beginning, whereas return to an outcome is a lateral branch of the same root. It remains anchored in the explicit first-creation comparison and the achieved arrival; downstream prose should present it as a folded beginning-to-outcome resonance, not as the grammar's sole sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: "The first time" joins the root's beginning sense to a branch in which a thing returns to its outcome.

activation_trace.role: Return to a final outcome lets the word for firstness laterally fold origin toward culmination.
Originary creation supplies the beginning whose trajectory can be read toward its outcome.
Obtained arrival supplies the realized endpoint in the focus scene.

changed_reading.before: First creation and final return are two analogous events.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the beginning already carries an orientation toward its outcome, so present arrival unfolds the first creation's latent terminus.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping from the appointment root to counting and scheduled recurrence. The row and exhaustive enumeration keep it functionally anchored, but downstream prose should call it a form-distant counting resonance rather than equating "appointment" with "census."
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The appointment's split inventory includes counted time and recurrence, beside the focus row.

activation_trace.role: Counted and recurrent time makes the appointment resonate as a scheduled reckoning.
Straight alignment supplies a visible ordering compatible with roll-call or reckoning.
Exhaustive enumeration gives the scheduled encounter an explicit counting operation.
The repeated appointment reinforces a calibrated term rather than an indefinite threat.

changed_reading.before: The appointment names only a fixed future time or place.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also resonates as a calibrated reckoning in which the aligned people and their acts are exhaustively counted.

strongest_changes: The row becomes the no-omission human geometry of an uncovered landscape and exhaustive mustering.
Presentation expands into an evidentiary field where agents, record, and performed acts are concurrently inspectable.
The repeated root in 18:57 reverses voluntary turning-away into compelled presentation with deeds already sent ahead.
The denied appointment is reframed as mercifully delayed rather than absent, fixed at both personal and communal scale.
summary.what_was_special: The focus concentrates several reversals without forcing them into one reading: transient display becomes exposed persons, turning-aside becomes being displayed, first creation becomes the measure of return, and apparent delay becomes the mercy internal to a fixed deadline.
remaining_uncertainties: The comparison with first creation may concern restored condition, demonstrated capacity, originary measure, or several of these at once.
The rival-agency model is well sequenced but its causal link to denying the appointment remains reader-supplied.
The beginning-to-outcome and counted-appointment readings depend on lateral or split branches and should remain explicitly exploratory.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الرب بمعنى الله تعالى، ومالك الشيء، وسيده المطاع، وصاحبه، ورب الدار والدابة والملك
branches.source_phrase_ar: الرب: الله تبارك وتعالى؛ ورب كل شيء مالكه (jamhara); رب كل شئ: مالكه؛ وقد قالوه في الجاهلية للملك؛ رببت القوم: سستهم (sihah); يكون الرب: المالك؛ ويكون الرب: السيد المطاع؛ ويكون الرب: المصلح (tahdhib); الرب مصدر مستعار للفاعل؛ لا يقال الرب مطلقا إلا لله؛ رب الدار ورب الفرس (mufradat); فالرب المالك والخالق والصاحب؛ والله جل ثناؤه الرب (maqayis)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه رب الشيء إذا أصلحه وأتمه وقام عليه، ورب النعمة والصنيعة والضيعة والولد والصبي، والتربية حالا فحالا
يدخل فيه الرباني والربانيون بمعنى العلماء والحكماء وأهل العلم بالرب أو من يرب العلم ونفسه به
يدخل فيه الربة والجماعات الكثيرة، والربيون إذا فسروا بالألوف أو الجماعات، ورباب القبائل لاجتماعهم
يدخل فيه الربيب والربيبة للولد المربوب من زوج سابق، والراب والرابة لمن يقوم على أمره، والحاضنة
يدخل فيه الرُّبّ الطلاء الخاثر أو ثفل السمن والزيت، والسقاء والنحي والأديم والدواء والطعام إذا جعل فيه الرُّبّ أو أصلح به
يدخل فيه رب أو أرب بالمكان إذا أقام، ومرب الإبل ومرابها، وأربت السحابة أو الجنوب إذا دامت، والإرباب بمعنى الدنو
يدخل فيه الرباب والربابة للسحاب، والسحاب المتعلق أو المركب بعضه على بعض، وما سمي بذلك لتربية النبات أو دوام المطر
يدخل فيه الشاة الرُّبّى والرباب لقرب العهد بالولادة أو لزوم البيت للبن، وربان الشيء بمعنى حدثانه وطراءته، وربى الشباب
يدخل فيه الربابة للجلدة أو الوعاء الذي تجمع فيه القداح أو سهام الميسر، وجماعة السهام نفسها
يدخل فيه الربابة والرباب للعهد والميثاق والجوار، والأربة للمعاهدين، والرباب للعشور إذا جعل كالعهد
يدخل فيه الربة والربب لضرب من الشجر أو النبت أو البقلة التي تبقى خضراء
يدخل فيه الربب للماء الكثير، ويقال للعذب، من جهة اجتماع الماء
يدخل فيه الربرب لقطيع بقر الوحش، وقيل لجماعة البقر أو الإبل
يدخل فيه رب وربما وربت وربه كحرف خافض أو حرف معنى للتقليل، ودخول ما أو التاء أو الهاء عليه
يدخل فيه الربى بمعنى الحاجة، والرابة، والعقدة المحكمة، والنعمة والإحسان
يدخل فيه الرباني لرئيس الملاحين

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ربا الشيء إذا زاد أو ارتفع، وربت الأرض إذا انتفخت وزادت، والرابي الزائد أو العالي، وأربى عليه إذا أشرف أو زاد عليه.
يدخل فيه الربوة والرابية والرباوة والرباة وما ارتفع من الأرض، مع اختلاف لغات الكلمة.
يدخل فيه الربا في البيع أو القرض، والزيادة على رأس المال، والربية لغة أو اسم خاص للربا.
يدخل فيه الربو بمعنى النفس العالي أو البهر أو الانبهار، وما يصيب الإنسان أو الدابة من علو النفس أو الانتفاخ من مشي أو عدو أو فزع.
يدخل فيه ربيت الولد أو تربيته بمعنى غذوته، وربا الولد أو الزرع بالنماء، وربوت أو ربيت في القوم بمعنى نشأت فيهم.
يدخل فيه الأربية أو الأربيتان بمعنى أصل الفخذ أو لحمتين ناتئتين في أصول الفخذين من باطن.
يدخل فيه قولهم جاء في أربية قومه أي في أهل بيته من بني الأعمام ونحوهم.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تمام الخلق، اعتدال الصورة، ظهور التصوير، والهيئات والأشكال المدركة بالبصر.
يدخل فيه الخلق والخليقة والطبيعة والسليقة والفطرة والمروءة والدين من جهة الصفة الباطنة والمعاشرة بها.
يدخل فيه خليق بكذا، أخلق به، مخلقة للخير، وما يكون الشخص كأنه مهيأ أو مقدر لذلك.
يدخل فيه الخلاق بمعنى النصيب والحظ، ولا سيما النصيب من الخير أو الآخرة أو الدين.
يدخل فيه خلق الكذب واختلاقه وتخلقه، الكلام المزور أو المفتعل، والخرافات المنسوبة أو المنحولة.
يدخل فيه الأملس المصمت، الصخرة الخلقاء، استواء السحاب أو الرسم، السهم أو القدح أو الحبل المملس، ومواضع الجبهة والوجه والظهر والغار المسماة خلقاء أو خليقاء.
يدخل فيه خلق الثوب وأخلق، الثوب الخلق والأخلاق، التمزق والبلى وذهاب الزئبر أو أثر الاستعمال.
يدخل فيه الخلوق المعروف من الطيب، التخليق والتخلق به، وطلاء غيره بالخلوق.
يدخل فيه الخليقة بمعنى النقرة في الصفا أو الصخرة يجتمع فيها ماء السماء، والدحلان والآبار الحديثة الحفر.
يدخل فيه وصف المرأة الرتقاء أو الخلقاء من جهة الانسداد والإصمات المشبه بالصفاة الخلقاء.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar geri dönüş, son varış ve sonuç anlamlarında birleşir; sözün açıklanması da onu ulaşacağı anlama veya sonuca bağlayan özel bir kullanımdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Geri dönüşü, son duruma ulaşmayı ve sözün varacağı anlama bağlanmasını ortak çekirdekte anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Geri dönme, sonuca varma ve anlamı açıklamak üzere ona döndürme bağını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir varlığın süreç sonunda ulaştığı durum yüklemle belirtildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir son duruma varma yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Geri dönme ve sözü anlamına döndürerek açıklama yönlerini dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir sözün neye vardığı veya ne demek olduğu ortaya konurken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sözü varacağı anlama döndürme yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel geri dönüş ve bir son duruma varma yönlerini dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal genel olarak olma ve bir şeyi oldurma alanına uzanır; odak dalda geri dönüş bağı ve sözün sonucunu ya da anlamını açıklama özel olarak belirgindir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه آل يؤول بمعنى رجع أو صار، والمآل والمرجع والمصير، وتأويل الكلام بمعنى ما يؤول إليه أو تفسيره برده إلى معناه.
branches.source_phrase_ar: آل يؤول أى رجع؛ تأويل الكلام وهو عاقبته وما يؤول إليه (maqayis)؛ التأويل تفسير ما يؤول إليه الشئ؛ آل أي رجع (sihah)؛ آل يؤول أي رجع وعاد؛ التأويل المرجع والمصير (tahdhib)

branches.branch_image_ar: آل الرجل من يرجع إليهم ويرجعون إليه
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه آل الرجل: أهل بيته وعياله وقرابته وأتباعه ومن إليه مآل الرجل أو مآلهم إليه، مع استعمال آل فلان في الرجل نفسه على جهة التعبير عنه بآله.
يدخل فيه الإيالة والسياسة، وآل الأمير رعيته إذا ساسها، وآل ماله إذا أصلحه، والائتيال والإصلاح وجمع الأمر أو رد الضالة في الدعاء.

branches.branch_image_ar: خثور السائل وانعقاده في آخر أمره
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه آل اللبن أو النبات أو القطران أو العسل إذا خثر أو انعقد، والآيل اللبن الخاثر.
يدخل فيه الآل بمعنى الشخص أو ما يتراءى في أول النهار وآخره ويرفع الشخوص، وأطراف الشيء ونواحيه كآل الجبل والبعير والخيمة.

branches.branch_image_ar: آلة الحال التي يكون عليها الشيء
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الآلة أو الألة بمعنى الحالة، كقولهم هو بآلة سوء.
يدخل فيه الآلة بمعنى الأداة، وخشبات الخيمة، والجنازة أو الحامل الذي يحمل عليه.
يدخل فيه الأيل: ذكر الوعول، مع تعليل تسميته بأنه يؤول إلى الجبل يتحصن.
يدخل فيه الإيال: وعاء يجمع فيه الشراب أياما حتى يجود.
يدخل فيه التأويل اسما لنبت أو بقلة ترعاها البهائم، كما ورد في تهذيب اللغة.

root_profile.summary: Bu kök, başlangıç ve öncelikten sonuca dönmeye, aile bağından iyi yönetime, fiziksel koyulaşmadan görünür siluete, durum ve araca kadar birçok ayrı dala yayılır; ayrıca bir erkek yabani dağ keçisini, içecek olgunlaştırma kabını ve özel bir yem bitkisini adlandırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, düşmanın karşıtı olan yakın tarafı, sevgi, destek, dostluk, inanç veya anlaşma bağıyla yanında olmayı birlikte verir. Bu dalda yakınlık, yönetim değil, taraf tutan ve yardım eden ilişki olarak işler.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir eylemin tek bir gerçekleşmesini, birden çok gerçekleşmesini ve bunların zamanın bir parçası olarak sayılmasını açıkça bir araya getirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım tek kerelik birim ile tekrarlı kullanımı ayırır; bu kullanımlardan yalın bir hareket ya da geçiş anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir eylemin tek bir gerçekleşmesi ya da bu gerçekleşmenin zaman içinde sayılabilir bir birim oluşturmasıdır. Çoğul veya yinelemeli kullanım, eylemin birbiri ardınca birkaç kez gerçekleştiğini bildirir.

Aynı eylemin iki ya da daha çok kez gerçekleşmesi tekrarlı biçimlerle sayılır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه مرة ومرتين ومرارا وذات المرار، أي وقوع الفعل في مرة أو مرات أو في جزء من الزمان.
branches.source_phrase_ar: لقيته مرة ومرتين عبارة عن زمان قد مر (maqayis)؛ المر المرة (ayn)؛ جئتك مرا أو مرين تريد مرة أو مرتين (jamhara)؛ يصنع ذلك الأمر ذات المرار (sihah)؛ يصنعه مرارا ويدعه مرارا (tahdhib)؛ مرة ومرتين وذلك لجزء من الزمان (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه مر الشيء وأمر إذا صار مرا، والمرارة ضد الحلاوة، والطعام أو الماء أو الدواء أو النبات المر، وما نسب إلى المرارة في المطعوم.
يدخل فيه إطلاق المرارة على الشر والشدة والدواهي، مثل الأمرين والأمرين والأمران، وما يدل على مرارة الفقر أو الهرم أو الهم أو المرض.
يدخل فيه أمررت الحبل وإمراره، والمر والمرار والممر والمرير للحبل المفتول أو شديد الفتل، وقوى الحبل ومرره.
يدخل فيه ذو مرة بمعنى قوي صحيح، والمرة قوة البدن أو العقل، والمريرة بمعنى العزيمة أو عزة النفس، واستمرار المريرة واستحكام العزم أو الخصومة.
يدخل فيه المرة مزاجا من أمزجة الجسد أو داء، والمرارة التي تكون في الحيوان، والممرور الذي غلبت عليه المرة.
يدخل فيه الأمر بمعنى المصارين التي يجتمع فيها الفرث، وما ألحق به من كلام المصادر في المرى أو المريان إذا كان من مرارة الخصال لا من المرور.

root_profile.summary: Kök, geçip gitme ve olayın kereliğinden acı tada, ağır sıkıntıya, sıkı burulmuş ipe, beden ve irade gücüne, eski beden sıvısı anlayışına ve bağırsak adına uzanan sekiz ayrı dal taşır. Son dalda bağırsak adıyla iki acı huy ifadesi aynı iddiada birleştiği için yapısal ayrıştırma gerekir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, doğruluğu kesinleşmemiş bir sözü aktarma çekirdeğini destekler; ancak aktarılan sözün zorunlu olarak yalan olmadığını, doğru da yanlış da olabileceğini açıkça belirtir. Bu nedenle dal, kesin yalan söyleme olarak değil, çoğu kez kuşku veya yalan ihtimali taşıyan söz aktarımı olarak sınırlandırılmıştır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, doğrulanmamış söz aktarma çekirdeğini korur; türemiş biçimlerdeki yalanlama, güvenilmez iddia ve hayvanın semizliğinden kuşku duyma kullanımlarını bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel gerçekleşmeler olarak ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir sözü doğruluğu kesinleşmeden aktarmak veya ileri sürmektir; söz doğru ya da yanlış olabilir, fakat kullanım çoğu kez kuşku ve yalan ihtimali taşır. Türemiş kullanımlar, yalan yere iddiayı, güvenilmeyen söz veya işi ve semizliği belirsiz hayvanı bu güvenilmezlik ekseninde adlandırır.

facets.statement: Bir söz, doğruluğu ve kesinliği sağlanmadan aktarılır veya ileri sürülür.
Aktarılan söz doğru da yanlış da olabilir; kullanımın ağırlık noktası kesin yalan değil, kuşku ve doğrulanmamışlıktır.
Bazı türemiş biçimler yalan söylemeyi, yalan yere iddiayı veya güvenilmeyen söz ve işleri belirtir.
Aynı güvenilmezlik örüntüsü, semiz olup olmadığı bilinmeyen ve elle yoklanan hayvan için de kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, doğruluğu kesinleşmemiş bir sözü aktarma veya ileri sürme çekirdeğinde birleşir; kullanım çoğu kez kuşku veya yalan ihtimali taşır, ancak söz her durumda yanlış değildir. Semizliği kuşkulu hayvan uzantısı Maqayis, Sihah ve Tahdhib'de; doğrulanmamış aktarımda kullanılan özel kuşku sözü yalnız Tahdhib'de yer alır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: القول من غير صحة ولا يقين والتزعم الكذب والزعوم التي يشك في سمنها (maqayis)؛ إذا شك في قوله وبزعمهم أي بقولهم الكذب والتزعم التكذب (ayn)؛ زعم أي قال والأمر الذي لا يوثق به مزعم وفي قول فلان مزاعم وناقة زعوم وشاة زعوم (sihah)؛ الزعم يكون حقا ويكون باطلا وبزعمهم أي بقولهم الكذب والزعم والتزاعم أكثر ما يقال فيما يشك فيه ولا يحقق (tahdhib)؛ الزعم حكاية قول يكون مظنة للكذب (mufradat)

root_profile.summary: Kök, yüzme ve yüzmeye benzer ilerlemeden yıl ve yıllık süreye; dönüşümlü ürün, yıllara bağlı işlem, sal, uzaktan görünen sarıklı baş, seçkin olanı ayırma, hasadı yığma ve yıllar arası karşılaşmaya uzanan belirgin biçimde ayrışmış anlam dalları taşır. Dalların bir bölümü hareket veya yıllık zaman çevresinde ilişkilenirken bir bölümü bağımsız araç, görünüş, seçim ve toplama anlamlarıdır.

concept_gloss.text: Suda yüzme eylemi ve gemi, deve, yıldız ya da at gibi bir varlığın yüzüyormuşçasına akıcı biçimde ilerlemesidir. Ayrıca suda yüzen küçük bir canlıyı adlandırabilir.
Bir kış ile bir yazı içine alan yıllık zaman çevrimidir. Çoğul yılları bildiren bir kalıpta aynı zaman fikri pekiştirme amacıyla yinelenebilir.
